title: Graphic Designer
description:
Role & responsibilities Effectively conceptualize, design, and execute all visuals to support Gympiks marketing efforts on digital and print media. Create social media graphics, digital campaign creatives, email banners, GIFs, videos, posters, and infographics as per the marketing calendar. Retouch, correct, and color-grade videos and graphic media. Assemble raw footage, digitally cut files, and create the final video as per the script with copywriters. Select, edit, and incorporate third-party content (stills, footage, music, graphics, etc.) as required. Requirements Strong command of graphic design with advanced knowledge of Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, Dreamweaver, After Effects, and Premiere Pro. Graduation Degree, diploma, or demonstrated experience in Visual Communication, Web Design, Graphic Design, Illustration, Video Editing, or a related field. Experience as a Visual Designer, Video Editor, or in a similar role. Design experience across digital assets including advertising, electronic newsletters, basic HTML, banners, video editing, social media, and digital media. Ability to understand product and brand strategy for creating a visual language. Familiarity with visual design processes such as mood boards, social media designs, email designs, print designs, and brand videos. Ability to deliver visual mock-ups in an iterative, agile environment. Strong eye for aesthetics and detail, with the ability to conceptualize and create visuals with copywriters with minimal supervision. Experience with digital marketing channels and social media is an added advantage. Ability to shoot videos using a camera, including knowledge of microphones, backdrops, audio editing, green screen, and video editing.

Key Skills: Adobe Premiere,Illustrator,Corel Draw,Graphic Designing,Draw,Graphics,Adobe,Design
